description: This PHP source file defines the SystemConfiguration class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods for retrieving and setting system configurations, such as organization info, default language, administrator details, and managing registration event queues.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: A utility class for managing system configuration and setup details within OrangeHRM, including organization info, language preferences, administrator data, instance identification, and event queue management.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Retrieves the organization name from the database or returns 'Not Captured'.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the country information from the database or returns 'Not Captured'.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Gets the system's default language, falls back to 'en_US' if not set.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Retrieve the first name of the admin user based on the admin employee number.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Retrieve the last name of the admin user based on the admin employee number.

methods.name: getAdminEmail
methods.description: Retrieve the admin user's email address from the database.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieve the admin user's contact number.

methods.name: getAdminUserName
methods.description: Retrieve the username of the admin.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches the system's unique instance identifier from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the admin employee number.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates and sets a new system instance identifier based on org info, admin, host, etc.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64 string as system instance ID from provided parameters.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the registration event queue table exists in the database.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new registration event record into the queue, with optional data and event time.
